text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I visited the shrine together with Rhein 
Kraft, who hasn't been feeling well 
lately.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Howaaa, what lovely weather~. It's a 
perfect day for sunbathing~.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Oh, Craft-san. What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san, hello~. Are you here to pray 
today?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Just for a change of pace. I've been 
cooped up in my room organizing data all 
this time, after all."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you totally exhausted, by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I feel a slight fatigue around my eyes, 
but there is no need for concern.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You know, I know the perfect place for a 
change of pace. Would you like to come 
along, Messiah-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I would love to visit. But... aren't Craft 
and the others planning to go make their 
shrine visit?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~, maybe I'll visit the shrine later.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the sun is just so warm and cozy 
today.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Maybe God is taking an afternoon nap too?
choice_data_list: True. It'd be bad to interrupt a nap.

True. It'd be bad to get in the way of a 
nap, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So, let's all go sunbathe together~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Warm sunlight filtering through the trees, 
a pleasant breeze... It's such a peaceful, 
relaxing place, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It truly lives up to your recommendation, 
Craft-san. Thanks to the greenery, the 
fatigue in my eyes seems to be melting 
away."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, looking at green is 
supposed to be good for your eyes, right? 
Ehehe, I'm glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mnyaaa~. Soaking up all that sun felt so 
nice~

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. All of my fatigue has completely 
vanished, and I feel fully refreshed.
choice_data_list:
Shall we pay our respects and head home, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's about time for God to wake up 
from His afternoon nap, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I feel like we'll receive some great 
blessings!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the wonderful shrine 
visit, Rhein Kraft was able to regain her 
form.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've soaked up plenty of sun. Shall 
we visit the shrine and head home?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, young ladies. There's a shrine 
event tonight, so from here on out the 
grounds are off-limits.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but could you come visit the 
shrine another time?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaaaaahn!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is unfortunate, but it cannot be 
helped. Let us take our leave before we 
cause any trouble.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That's true...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because she was unable to pray at 
the shrine, Rhein Kraft seemed unable to 
regain her top form.
